CustomObject.description: Represents a triggered shipment event for a third-party manufacturer repair (RMA). Published when a repair work order is routed to a vendor and when the repaired unit is returned (two directions: Outbound-to-vendor and Return-from-vendor). In the demo this stands in for a MuleSoft-to-carrier (FedEx/UPS/DHL) integration; no live carrier API call is made. Mirrors the SAP_Reconciliation__e publish-only stub pattern.
CustomObject.label: Shipment
